provenance.note: Service rifles with a scope introduced after 1 January 1965 and civil versions of service rifles. D.11.15 restates no distance, the record takes the 100 m of ZG 1 (D.11.13). Scored in its own class. Only the weapon rule deviates from ZG 1 (D.11.15); the other rules are read from ZG 1. Sighters and times are not set because the target plan differs.
